name: Oregon

statute.name: Oregon Public Records Law
statute.citation: ORS 192.311 et seq. (right to inspect: ORS 192.314(1))

response.rule_text: Custodian must acknowledge or complete response to a written request within five business days (ORS 192.324) and generally complete within 15 business days (ORS 192.329(5)); failure to respond in time is treated as denial (ORS 192.407(1)).

fees.labor_rule: Fee reasonably calculated to reimburse actual cost, may include search and segregation; attorney time for redaction but not exemption determinations (ORS 192.324(4)).
fees.copy_rule: Per-page fee reasonably calculated to reimburse actual cost; custodian bears burden of showing reasonableness.
fees.waiver_rule: Waiver or reduction where disclosure primarily benefits the general public (ORS 192.324(5)); denial appealable (192.324(6)).
fees.estimate_required: Estimate and confirmation required if fee will exceed $25 (ORS 192.324(4)(c)).
fees.late_penalty: Prevailing requester awarded attorney fees and costs (ORS 192.431(3)).

residency.rule_text: Every person, regardless of nationality or residency, has a right to inspect any public record not expressly exempt (ORS 192.314(1)).

appeal.body: Attorney General (state bodies) or district attorney (local bodies); circuit court for elected officials
appeal.rule_text: Petition AG (ORS 192.411) or DA (ORS 192.415), who must rule within seven days or petition deemed denied (ORS 192.418); elected officials go straight to circuit court (192.427). Requester has no specific time limit; Public Records Advocate offers mediation (ORS 192.461-192.475).

format_rule: Copy in the form requested if available, otherwise in the form maintained (ORS 192.324(3)).
notes: Read chars 0-200k. Legislative Assembly not subject; other legislative bodies are. OHSU-type public corporations covered; other public universities not explicitly addressed. Appeal filing deadline heading empty in RCFP. response.days uses the 5-business-day acknowledgment; completion is 15 business days.
